The '''Galactic League''' was a major [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] competition that was competed during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], the [[Commenor Diamonds]] defeated the [[Kuat Artisans]] in the final to win the League. The following year, the Kuat Artisans were victorious and won the League as a result of the efforts of their star players [[Gettle Tebron]] and [[Kob Mondray]].<ref name="TEGTW AC 8">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>
